en.title: Appointment list
en.summary: Every appointment at the branch chosen in the top bar — or at all branches.

sections.heading: Finding appointments
sections.body: Search by the patient's names in any order, their file number or any phone. The column headers filter by status, what the visit was for, dentist and chair; Flags narrows to first visits or short-notice patients; Date narrows to a window. Charts draws the same counts — useful for no-shows by dentist.

sections.heading: Opening one
sections.body: Click the date to open the appointment on its day in the day view, where it can be moved, checked in or cancelled.

am.title: የቀጠሮ ዝርዝር
am.summary: በላይኛው አሞሌ በተመረጠው ቅርንጫፍ — ወይም በሁሉም ቅርንጫፎች — ያሉ ቀጠሮዎች በሙሉ።

sections.heading: ቀጠሮዎችን መፈለግ
sections.body: በታካሚው ስሞች፣ በፋይል ቁጥር ወይም በስልክ ይፈልጉ። የዓምድ ራሶቹ በሁኔታ፣ በጉብኝት ዓይነት፣ በሐኪምና በወንበር ያጣራሉ፤ "Date" በቀን ክልል ያጣራል። ቻርቶቹ ተመሳሳይ ቁጥሮችን ያሳያሉ።

sections.heading: አንዱን መክፈት
sections.body: ቀጠሮውን በቀኑ እይታ ለመክፈት ቀኑን ይጫኑ፤ እዚያ ማዛወር፣ መመዝገብ ወይም መሰረዝ ይቻላል።
